content.short: Castle is a smart contract wallet for NFT collectors, enabling personal or shared vaults with multisig security.
content.description: Castle is a smart contract wallet for NFT collectors. It enables anyone to easily create and manage a shared or personal vault using multi-signature wallet technology. Individuals can use Castle as a vault to securely store assets, or as a trading wallet with features like advanced portfolio tracking and batch transactions. Groups can use Castle as a shared wallet to pool funds, buy NFTs, manage a shared treasury, and split profits. Native integrations with OpenSea, Gem.xyz and Genie.xyz aggregate NFTs from multiple marketplaces, allowing you to buy or sell several NFTs in a single transaction, sweep the floor, or list multiple NFTs at once. You can purchase NFTs and list them in one transaction via Castle's native marketplace, and track portfolio data such as NFT floor prices, purchase prices, and token balances. You can also invite friends to join a group, contribute funds, and manage ownership settings.
